evidence.title: GetLayers AI — An AI-native library of templates.

name: GetLayers AI
summary: Prompt-first library of web assets: 49 templates, 114 3D WebGL scenes, 78 backgrounds, 10 animated sections and 1,088 gradients.
description: GetLayers (by design studio Textura) is a library of web design layers: page and hero templates, real-time 3D WebGL scenes, animated and static backgrounds, animated sections and interactive WebGL gradients. Every layer can be copied as one self-contained prompt and rebuilt by an AI coding agent, or downloaded as Next.js source on paid plans; an MCP server connects the library to agent clients.
contains: 1,088 interactive gradients (~1 KB each, pure WebGL2)
every layer copies as one prompt; paid plans add source
MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and other clients
